jobs.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for senior React Native engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers

jobs.excerpt: Come join a growing financial technology company that's leading the marketplace in both the marketing and servicing of credit cards!
jobs.description:
Come join a growing financial technology company that's leading the marketplace in both the marketing and servicing of credit cards! Continental Finance Company specializes in credit card options for consumers with less than perfect credit.

We are seeking a creative UI Developer with a passion for building intuitive, polished user experiences to support our Technology team. We are seeking a UI Developer with strong experience in React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end architecture. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining responsive, accessible, high-performance user interfaces for our customer-facing and internal applications. You'll work closely with product, design, and back-end engineers (who work primarily in .NET Core and AWS) to turn ideas into seamless digital experiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced setting, can work independently, has a strong eye for detail, and contributes to front-end architecture and UI standards across teams. This position will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with our financial services products.
